svg.title: IMG-04-04 Home page of the web interface, with callouts
svg.desc: Screenshot of the real Home page template (amr_web home.html, base.html) rendered with representative mock state, ui=l, 1280 x 720. Headline from amr_web/alarms.py standing() and headline() (supervisor fault BOOT_ERROR), status tile layout of 2026-11-12/14. Inset: the same page after the connection was dropped.

text.tspan: Status bar: mode, selector, drives, command, run
State in one line; tile colour = state
One button for the action, e.g.
Grey bar: last known values, not live
Mode: selector at AUTO or MANUAL
